brief: The Beyond: a tilted stone observation platform with one large hollow forged ring fixed into its rear edge. One suspended-looking distant mass in the backdrop only; visible platform supports, muted plum sky, no eye emblem.
The Beyond: two unequal pale stone platforms joined by a single narrow bent bridge over a dark chasm. The route forms a low S; sparse sage cloth tied to a fitted post, broad shadows, no figures.

The Beyond: a tall opaque stone reservoir with a narrow green-glass inspection slit and one curved drain into a shallow bowl. Continuous forged brackets, three clear material groups; no potion bottle or relic.

Encounter location concept: an iron lift cage suspended on a visibly continuous thick chain beside a worn stone landing. Open empty cage, three-quarter low diagonal platform, muted copper fittings. No character or promise of mechanics.

Encounter location concept: a broad dark doorway partially revealed by a heavy asymmetric plum curtain held by a simple forged hook. Three large cloth folds, thick stone jamb and one cream floor wedge; no treasure or readable script.

Encounter location concept: a cracked suspended iron bell fitted to an asymmetric stone support, clapper resting visibly inside the dark mouth. Unequal opening and thick edge; a single draped sage cloth on the stone base. No character.
